title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - CollectionOfBuildings
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/CollectionOfBuildings. Multiple buildings, not necessarily grouped spatially and not necessarily sharing any characteristics. Subclass of s4envi:Perimeter (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.9); location and population are inherited from the Perimeter model, not repeated here. This class additionally narrows saref:consistsOf, at its own level, to range over Building specifically (ontology restriction: allValuesFrom Building) -- distinct from (and in addition to) the inherited Perimeter-level consistsOf relationship to WasteProducer, which is not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CollectionOfBuildings'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

consistsOf.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/consistsOf'. A collection of buildings consists exclusively of Building entities (ontology restriction: allValuesFrom Building), narrower than the Perimeter-level consistsOf->WasteProducer relationship documented on the Perimeter model. Links to Building entities.
